description: Public NTP service ams0.ntp: clock health and upstream sources from chrony_exporter, server counters from chrony serverstats, and client traffic at the gateway from Akvorado (raw flows table; rollups drop ports).
title: NTP (chrony)

panels.title: Exporter up
panels.description: chrony_up per pod: 0 means the exporter could not talk to chronyd.

panels.title: Stratum
panels.description: Highest stratum across the pods. 16 means unsynchronised.

panels.title: Max clock error
panels.description: Worst pod: |last offset| + root dispersion + root delay / 2, the bound chronyc documents.

panels.title: System clock offset
panels.description: Worst pod: how far the kernel clock is from chrony's estimate of true time. Positive is fast.

panels.title: Selected sources
panels.description: Sources in state sync across the pods (one per pod when healthy).

panels.title: Unreachable sources
panels.description: Sources whose last 8 polls all failed.

panels.title: Reference per pod
panels.description: The source each pod is synchronised to.

panels.title: System clock offset
panels.description: chrony_tracking_system_time_seconds. chronyd runs with -x, so it measures the node clock but does not steer it; Talos' own timesyncd does.

panels.title: Clock error bound
panels.description: |last offset| + root dispersion + root delay / 2 per pod.

panels.title: Last and RMS offset
panels.description: Offset of the last clock update, and its long-term RMS.

panels.title: Root delay and dispersion
panels.description: Round trip and accumulated error back to the stratum 1 servers.

panels.title: Frequency
panels.description: Frequency error of the node clock, and how uncertain it is (skew).

panels.title: Sources
panels.description: State, stratum, reach and the last sample of every upstream source, per pod.

targets.expr: chrony_sources_stratum{pod=~"$pod"} * on (pod, source_address, source_name) group_left (source_state, source_mode) chrony_sources_state_info{pod=~"$pod"}
chrony_sources_reachability_ratio{pod=~"$pod"} * on (pod, source_address, source_name) group_left (source_state, source_mode) chrony_sources_state_info{pod=~"$pod"}
chrony_sources_last_sample_offset_seconds{pod=~"$pod"} * on (pod, source_address, source_name) group_left (source_state, source_mode) chrony_sources_state_info{pod=~"$pod"}
chrony_sources_last_sample_error_margin_seconds{pod=~"$pod"} * on (pod, source_address, source_name) group_left (source_state, source_mode) chrony_sources_state_info{pod=~"$pod"}
chrony_sources_polling_interval_seconds{pod=~"$pod"} * on (pod, source_address, source_name) group_left (source_state, source_mode) chrony_sources_state_info{pod=~"$pod"}

panels.title: Source offsets
panels.description: Last sample offset of each source. A source far from the rest is a falseticker.

panels.title: Source jitter
panels.description: Standard deviation of each source's recent samples (chronyc sourcestats Std Dev).

panels.title: NTP requests
panels.description: NTP packets received by chronyd, per pod. Each pod serves the clients its node's L2 lease or the IPv4 port forward sends it (externalTrafficPolicy Local).

panels.title: Dropped by rate limit
panels.description: NTP requests chronyd dropped (ratelimit), and client log records it had to recycle because the log was full.

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Total NTP requests over all pods.

panels.title: Dropped share
panels.description: Share of requests dropped by the rate limit.

panels.title: Clients in log
panels.description: Clients in chronyd's client log (NTP vs NTS). Saturates at clientloglimit (about 4096 per pod with the default 512 KiB).

panels.title: Interleaved
panels.description: Requests answered in interleaved mode (more accurate transmit timestamps).

panels.title: Kernel RX timestamps
panels.description: Share of received packets timestamped by the kernel rather than by chronyd.

panels.title: NTS-KE connections
panels.description: NTS key exchanges accepted. The pods do not serve NTS (no ntsserverkey), so this stays 0.

panels.title: Client poll interval
panels.description: How often each client in the log polls (chrony_clients_ntp_interval_seconds, cumulative buckets: clients polling at most every N seconds).

panels.title: Last request age
panels.description: Time since each client in the log last asked (cumulative buckets).

panels.title: Drops per client
panels.description: How many requests chronyd dropped per client (cumulative buckets). Clients past 2 or 5 are polling too fast.

panels.title: Requests by IP family
panels.description: Client requests arriving on the WAN to UDP 123. From Akvorado: the gateway samples 1 in 16 packets at random, so counts are scaled estimates and unique-client figures undercount.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeReceived) AS time, if(EType = 2048, 'IPv4', 'IPv6') AS family, sum(Packets * SamplingRate) / $__interval_s AS pps FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND Proto = 17 AND DstPort = 123 AND InIfBoundary = 'external' AND EType IN (${family:csv}) GROUP BY time, family ORDER BY time

panels.title: Bandwidth by direction
panels.description: Requests in and replies out, in bits per second. From Akvorado: the gateway samples 1 in 16 packets at random, so counts are scaled estimates and unique-client figures undercount.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeReceived) AS time, concat('in ', if(EType = 2048, 'IPv4', 'IPv6')) AS s, sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / $__interval_s AS bps FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND Proto = 17 AND DstPort = 123 AND InIfBoundary = 'external' AND EType IN (${family:csv}) GROUP BY time, s ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeReceived) AS time, concat('out ', if(EType = 2048, 'IPv4', 'IPv6')) AS s, -sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) * 8 / $__interval_s AS bps FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND Proto = 17 AND SrcPort = 123 AND OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND EType IN (${family:csv}) GROUP BY time, s ORDER BY time

panels.title: Requests in range
panels.description: Estimated client requests over the selected range. From Akvorado: the gateway samples 1 in 16 packets at random, so counts are scaled estimates and unique-client figures undercount.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(Packets * SamplingRate) AS requests FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND Proto = 17 AND DstPort = 123 AND InIfBoundary = 'external' AND EType IN (${family:csv})

panels.title: Traffic in range
panels.description: Estimated NTP bytes in plus out over the selected range. From Akvorado: the gateway samples 1 in 16 packets at random, so counts are scaled estimates and unique-client figures undercount.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(Bytes * SamplingRate) AS bytes FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND ((Proto = 17 AND DstPort = 123 AND InIfBoundary = 'external' AND EType IN (${family:csv})) OR (Proto = 17 AND SrcPort = 123 AND OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND EType IN (${family:csv})))

panels.title: Sampled clients
panels.description: Distinct client addresses seen in the sample. A lower bound: clients that poll rarely are often missed at 1:16. From Akvorado: the gateway samples 1 in 16 packets at random, so counts are scaled estimates and unique-client figures undercount.

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniq(SrcAddr) AS clients FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND Proto = 17 AND DstPort = 123 AND InIfBoundary = 'external' AND EType IN (${family:csv})

panels.title: Client networks
panels.description: Distinct source AS numbers in the sample.

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniq(SrcAS) AS networks FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND Proto = 17 AND DstPort = 123 AND InIfBoundary = 'external' AND EType IN (${family:csv})

panels.title: NTP share of WAN bytes
panels.description: NTP (both directions) as a share of all bytes crossing the WAN in the range.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sumIf(Bytes * SamplingRate, ((Proto = 17 AND DstPort = 123 AND InIfBoundary = 'external' AND EType IN (${family:csv})) OR (Proto = 17 AND SrcPort = 123 AND OutIfBoundary = 'external' AND EType IN (${family:csv})))) / sumIf(Bytes * SamplingRate, InIfBoundary = 'external' OR OutIfBoundary = 'external') AS share FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived)

panels.title: Sampled clients per family
panels.description: Distinct client addresses per IP family.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(EType = 2048, 'IPv4', 'IPv6') AS family, uniq(SrcAddr) AS clients FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND Proto = 17 AND DstPort = 123 AND InIfBoundary = 'external' AND EType IN (${family:csv}) GROUP BY family ORDER BY family

panels.title: IP family
panels.description: Share of client requests by IP family.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(EType = 2048, 'IPv4', 'IPv6') AS family, sum(Packets * SamplingRate) AS requests FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND Proto = 17 AND DstPort = 123 AND InIfBoundary = 'external' AND EType IN (${family:csv}) GROUP BY family

panels.title: Client source port
panels.description: Clients sending from port 123 are usually NTP daemons (ntpd, chrony, routers); ephemeral ports are SNTP clients and phones.

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(SrcPort = 123, 'port 123 (daemon)', 'ephemeral (SNTP)') AS kind, sum(Packets * SamplingRate) AS requests FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND Proto = 17 AND DstPort = 123 AND InIfBoundary = 'external' AND EType IN (${family:csv}) GROUP BY kind

panels.title: Packet size
panels.description: IP packet size of requests. 76 B (IPv4) and 96 B (IPv6) are plain 48-byte NTP; larger ones carry extension fields or MACs.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toString(PacketSize) AS size, sum(Packets * SamplingRate) AS requests FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND Proto = 17 AND DstPort = 123 AND InIfBoundary = 'external' AND EType IN (${family:csv}) GROUP BY size ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 8

panels.title: Sampled clients over time
panels.description: Distinct client addresses per interval, by family. From Akvorado: the gateway samples 1 in 16 packets at random, so counts are scaled estimates and unique-client figures undercount.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeReceived) AS time, if(EType = 2048, 'IPv4', 'IPv6') AS family, uniq(SrcAddr) AS clients FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND Proto = 17 AND DstPort = 123 AND InIfBoundary = 'external' AND EType IN (${family:csv}) GROUP BY time, family ORDER BY time

panels.title: Top countries
panels.description: Client requests by source country (GeoLite2).

targets.rawSql: SELECT if(SrcCountry = '', '??', SrcCountry) AS country, sum(Packets * SamplingRate) AS requests, uniq(SrcAddr) AS clients, round(100 * countIf(EType = 34525) / count(), 1) AS ipv6_pct FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND Proto = 17 AND DstPort = 123 AND InIfBoundary = 'external' AND EType IN (${family:csv}) GROUP BY country ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Top networks
panels.description: Client requests by source AS.

targets.rawSql: SELECT SrcAS AS asn, dictGetOrDefault('asns', 'name', SrcAS, '') AS name, sum(Packets * SamplingRate) AS requests, uniq(SrcAddr) AS clients FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND Proto = 17 AND DstPort = 123 AND InIfBoundary = 'external' AND EType IN (${family:csv}) GROUP BY asn ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 25

panels.title: Top clients
panels.description: The busiest client addresses. Heavy hitters here are what ratelimit drops.

targets.rawSql: SELECT replaceRegexpOne(IPv6NumToString(SrcAddr), '^::ffff:', '') AS client, any(SrcCountry) AS country, dictGetOrDefault('asns', 'name', any(SrcAS), '') AS network, sum(Packets * SamplingRate) AS requests, round(sum(Packets * SamplingRate) / greatest(1, dateDiff('second', $__fromTime, $__toTime)), 3) AS pps FROM flows WHERE $__timeFilter(TimeReceived) AND Proto = 17 AND DstPort = 123 AND InIfBoundary = 'external' AND EType IN (${family:csv}) GROUP BY SrcAddr ORDER BY requests DESC LIMIT 25
